newsitem.title: ITALY: Many airlines interested in Alitalia deal - govt.
newsitem.headline: Many airlines interested in Alitalia deal - govt.

text.p: Many airliners are interested in forming a partnership with Italian flag carrier Alitalia, but to date no deals have been agreed, the undersecretary at the transport ministry told reporters on Wednesday.
"We are very satisfied that after many years, interest in Alitalia has been rekindled," Giuseppe Albertini said.
"Many important companies want to reach a deal with Alitalia and we are convinced that it is necessary to find alliances," he said, adding that no agreement had yet been reached.
Dutch carrier KLM last Friday confirmed it was in talks with Alitalia on a possible alliance but played down reports they were at an advanced stage.

Air France has also been named by government officials as a possible partner for Italy's loss-making airline which had to be bailed out by the government earlier this year with a massive recapitalisation.
